items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What was his partner, Reb Spikes or something? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't remember now.

ctx.x: But there was a club there called, the Club Alabam. It was run by Curtis Mosby. They had a beautiful band in there too.
What was his partner, Reb Spikes or something? Some such name? Didn't Curtis Mosby have a partner?
